before.title: surroundings／environment／circumstances
before.content: surroundings 指住處環境，恆用複數；environment 指生態環境，常用單數；circumstances 指抽象環境，常用複數，常與 under 連用；under such circumstances：在這樣的環境下。

after.content: surroundings 指周圍的環境或事物，作複數名詞；environment 可指自然環境，也可指影響人或事物的條件／環境；circumstances 通常指情況／情勢，常與 under 連用，如 under such circumstances（在這種情況下）。

facts.reason: Qualify the home-only/ecology-only restrictions without deleting the existing distinctions.

before.title: be on the stage ＝ go on the stage

after.title: be on the stage；go on the stage

facts.reason: The source prints separate state/become phrases, not an equality; preserve both phrases and the Chinese content.

after.title: get a part in...；play the part of...
after.content: 獲得……（戲劇或電影）中的角色；扮演……（人物）的角色。

facts.reason: Separate obtaining a role in a work from playing the part of a character; preserve the note identity/type/status.
